structure.unit: Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, And Computing (Stem+C) Competition Team Grant Program

law.catch_line: Board to develop and issue grant guidelines; application; administration
law.text: The Board shall develop and issue guidelines for the general requirements of qualifying for a grant and shall develop the grant application form. Such guidelines shall be exempt from the provisions of the Administrative Process Act (§ 2.2-4000 et seq.).
